About the role

This role is ideal for students seeking practical work experience in administration, customer service, and operational support within a dynamic business environment. We are looking for enthusiastic and detail-oriented students to join our Gift Card Operations team during the festive period. 
What you'll do
  • Contact clients telephonically regarding gift card orders and delivery arrangements. 
  • Coordinate and schedule gift card deliveries with clients and service providers. 
  • Pack and prepare gift card orders accurately and efficiently. 
  • Generate and process customer invoices. 
  • Capture and maintain order information on the Bulk Gift Card System. 
  • Assist with general administrative tasks related to gift card sales and distribution. 
  • Ensure all orders are processed accurately and within agreed timelines. 
What you bring
  • Strong communication skills. 
  • Computer literate. 
  • Good organizational and time management skills. 
  • Ability to work under pressure during peak trading periods. 
  • Professional attitude and customer-focused approach.
